data.title: Ouster Raises the Bar on High-Altitude Drone Mapping with The World’s First Native Color Lidar and 2x Accuracy & Precision Breakthrough on REV8 OS1 Max
data.description: Ouster, Inc., a prominent player in sensing and perception technology for Physical AI, unveiled a rise in customer adoption for its Rev8 OS1 Max digital lidar sensor. This advanced sensor has been favored by payload integrators and drone OEMs in the aerial mapping sector for tasks such as utility corridor inspection, infrastructure management, and defense purposes. The Rev8 OS1 Max has gained traction due to its native color capabilities. Aerial mapping operations have traditionally faced limitations in resolving power lines, but Ouster's sensor presents a solution, enabling more effective mapping missions.

data.title: Memories, Printed WIDE - Fujifilm Introduces instax Link WIDE 2™ Smartphone Printer
data.description: VALHALLA, N.Y.--FUJIFILM North America Corporation, Imaging Division, has unveiled the new instax Link WIDE 2 smartphone printer, the updated version of its wide-format smartphone printer. Following the success of the original instax Link Wide smartphone printer from 2021, the Link WIDE 2 introduces new interactive features for instax wide instant photography enthusiasts. The latest product builds on the popularity of its predecessor and offers a variety of enhancements for fans of instax wide instant photography.

data.title: CORRECTED — Impact Biomedical Inc (NYSE: IBO) Announces 1 for 12.62 Reverse Stock Split to Pursue Completion of Merger with Zoar Limited (f/k/a Dr Ashleys Limited)
data.description: A press release was issued to correct the merger exchange ratio in Impact Biomedical Inc.'s announcement from September 11, 2026. It was initially stated that Impact stockholders would receive 1 share of Zoar Limited for every 4 shares of Impact Common Stock. However, the accurate exchange ratio, as per the Merger and Share Exchange Agreement, is 1 share of Zoar Limited for every 1 share of Impact Common Stock held before the merger's effective time, after the Reverse Stock Split. This update stems from a Form 8-K report dated June 23, 2025. The correction retains all other details from the original release.
